about:
Oak City Customs, founded in 2015, operates from Zebulon, North Carolina. The company manufactures all its custom furniture and fabrication at its facility there. No founders or ownership details are disclosed.

The shop produces a wide range of custom wood and metal furnishings, including dining tables, conference tables, epoxy river tables, coffee tables, waterfall tables, wood countertops, shelves, mantels, bench seats, and wood panels. It also supplies live edge wood slabs in species such as red oak, white oak, soft maple, walnut, parota, cedar, sycamore, poplar, sapele, ash, sweet gum, and pine, as well as reclaimed bourbon barrel wood. Table bases include teak, Guayaquil, and Guachipelin root designs. The facility handles both woodworking and metal fabrication, with capabilities for epoxy resin casting and custom design.

The company serves commercial and residential customers. Commercial clients include fire departments (firehouse logo tables), fraternities and sororities, and businesses needing conference tables and partitioned workstations. Residential buyers purchase dining sets, coffee tables, and outdoor furniture such as modular garden planters and poolside cabanas.

Oak City Customs emphasizes domestic production, stating that all custom products are manufactured at its Zebulon facility. Its "From Tree To Table®" branding and "Urban Lumber Process" video highlight a focus on sourcing and processing urban lumber into finished pieces.
